prompt: Why human beings die? Can they become immortal in future through scientific improvement
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 best fulfills the two-part prompt by explaining why humans die (natural causes and examples) and addressing whether scientific progress could make humans immortal, though it stays appropriately cautious.
